findings.title: Length-modulo padding detection breaks padded auth values containing newline or CR
findings.impact: The change picks the base64 decoder from len(field)%4. Go's base64 decoders skip \r and \n, but those characters still count toward the length. A padded auth value with a trailing or embedded newline, for example from a hand-edited or wrapped config, then has a length that is not a multiple of 4. It is sent to RawStdEncoding, which rejects the '=' padding. Such an entry used to decode, so it now fails with an error and the credentials are dropped. This is a compatibility regression that causes an authentication failure, not a security hole.
findings.recommendation: Strip whitespace first (strings.TrimSpace, or remove \r and \n) before measuring length. Alternatively, choose the decoder with strings.HasSuffix(trimmed, "="), or try StdEncoding and fall back to RawStdEncoding on error. Add a test for a padded value with a trailing newline.
